title: Little Fires Everywhere
author: Celeste Ng
summary: In the planned community of Shaker Heights, Ohio, the orderly Richardson family rents a house to an artist, Mia Warren, and her teenage daughter. A custody battle over a baby soon divides the town.
readIf: you like domestic fiction about families, class, race and the secrets in tidy suburbs.
skipIf: you want a fast plot, since it is a slow, character-driven story.

pairings.reason: Another novel about suburban mothers, secrets and a community that polices itself.
A larger family novel about a Midwestern household's quiet dysfunction.
